feed.title: Security Advisory for .NET packages hosted at the NuGet Gallery

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-arm64] ImageMagick: Use-After-Free when freetype initialization fails
entry.content:
When the freetype initialization fails the method does not exit and uses memory that was freed.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-6jwg-7q3p-5fqm
  • https://github.com/dlemstra/Magick.NET/releases/tag/14.15.0
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-6jwg-7q3p-5fqm

entry.title: [Magick.NET-Q16-HDRI-arm64] ImageMagick: Policy Bypass in script operation due to missing checks
entry.content:
The -script operation is missing policy checks and that could result in both reading from paths disallowed by the security policy.

References

  • https://github.com/ImageMagick/ImageMagick/security/advisories/GHSA-vghg-5jrg-2398
  • https://github.com/dlemstra/Magick.NET/releases/tag/14.15.0
  • https://github.com/advisories/GHSA-vghg-5jrg-2398
